stage: Independent read-only review of the private P3 offline spatial moment/symbol plan
result: No blocking numerical or provenance problem found in the authorized frozen audit. It can support root's predeclared admission decision for the four proposed actual32/64 coarse/half jobs; predictions are not actual continuum-accuracy acceptance.
scope: Only the existing offline plan, source/runner, outputs and sealed controls were read. Independent Python/NumPy/SciPy arithmetic was performed without compiling C++, starting a project solver/GenCase or modifying prior artifacts. This note is the only new authored artifact.

independent_provenance.retained_wrapper: r1 parse-only failure is retained. r2 accepts both ':' and '=' in the actual Run.out constants; it does not alter numerical tests/material or execute a project solver.

unchanged_physical_problem.initial_real128_validation: Independently decoded the first actual retained128x26 state:128 unique dyadic cell-centred (x,z),y0,J1,p/p0/six stresses0,and the exact stored float initial m1 sine velocity. New512/2048 offline coordinates are constructed lattices only, not accepted GenCase seeds.

actual_header_precision.kernel: Wendland actual header constants and ordered float sqrt/qq/multiplication/division were emulated independently; no idealized analytic normalization substituted.
actual_header_precision.h: h=double(float(1.8*dp)); kernel constants consume this promoted double, gradient factor returns float. Double-displacement correction gradients and actual float raw momentum/stress-gradient products remain distinct.
actual_header_precision.regularization: Eta2=float((h*.1)*(h*.1)) with double intermediates; support=float(2*h),support2=float(support*support). Double V=dp^2 and stress volume=float(V) are tracked; they are equal here only because the declared volumes are powers of two.

retained_16_control.meaning: The16-point-x grid's m1 control, not16 different spectral modes.

reference_review.state: The normalized3x3 finite-Kw dynamic coupled state is (v,Sxx,p). Its acceleration is Kr*(p-Sxx)/rho and the pressure rate combines -B*Ks*v-D*ell*p+D*rho_w*Ka*a. The independent cubic signs and dimensions match this matrix.
reference_review.displacement: The actual linearized integrator is explicit midpoint on (v,S,p), with trapezoidal u using the old and corrected velocities. It is not midpoint on an augmented (u,v,S,p) state; the offline runner handles this distinction correctly.
reference_review.independent_method: Independently formed a normalized augmented4x4 matrix, used scipy.linalg.expm to obtain continuum and frozen-discrete state plus integrated displacement at every257 exact time, and used numpy.linalg.matrix_power of the explicit-midpoint3x3 plus separate trapezoidal-u map. All six coarse/half scalar prediction sets and saved endpoints were compared without rerunning the original scripts.
reference_review.gate_basis: Original32768*binary64-epsilon scaled arithmetic bound, unchanged. The root/eigen imaginary and polynomial checks in the sealed audit were also reviewed; the independent matrix exponential avoids reusing its eigenvector-integration implementation.
reference_review.RMS: For this pure uniform m1 sinusoid, field RMS equals modal amplitude error/sqrt(2). Static A,Pstar,Ustar normalization avoids division by zero at startup. Actual tests must still compute full native vector fields, not substitute this modal identity when extra modes/noise are present.

fixed_neighbor_conclusion.floor: The dimensionless raw first moment and regularized quadratic Laplacian moment remain nonunit and unchanged under fixed h/dp refinement. Corrected divergence/stress-gradient affine reproduction does not correct the raw momentum or quadratic-Lstar bias. Finite-wavelength errors shrink, but exact/asymptotic convergence to the desired PDE is not established.
fixed_neighbor_conclusion.naming: Use Mraw_xx for the actual float raw-momentum moment. Mxx is the double-gradient moment; the plan's generic raw-first wording should not conflate their tiny but explicitly retained difference.
fixed_neighbor_conclusion.quadratic_scope: x²/2,z²/2,xz are local stencil moments, not globally periodic quadratic-pressure physical solutions.

actual_four_job_gate_recommendation.keep_old16: Adopt accepted time-policy16 coarse/half physical data; do not rerun it merely under a new label.
actual_four_job_gate_recommendation.sequence: After root authorization and actual new-geometry Debug smokes, fresh Release32 coarse/half then64 coarse/half only. Each grid's independent half gate must pass before accepting later dependent results; no repeated per-stage all-particle replay on every fine step.
actual_four_job_gate_recommendation.seed_gate: Real GenCase512/2048 native sets must match the dyadic cell-centred lattice/domain/wall-free counts and actual loaded constants. Bind source, executable/runtime, commands, initial BI4 and paired copied seed hashes. Offline constructed coordinates are not sufficient seed evidence. Validate initial actual-header symbols per grid before relying on predictions.
actual_four_job_gate_recommendation.unchanged_gates: Preserve native IDs/no exclusions,finite/elastic/J/n/V/rho/p0,solid-volume,periodic ownership,current-step/RH bounds,energy<=1.1 and all257 original5Pa/.005mm independent-half comparisons.
actual_four_job_gate_recommendation.additional_time_isolation: Predeclare and retain all-time full-field coarse/half RMS normalized by Pstar,A,Ustar <=1e-4, because the old displacement absolute limit alone is far too weak for this tiny wave.
actual_four_job_gate_recommendation.continuum_gate: For the finest actual accepted half trajectory require all-time full native pressure,velocity-vector and material-displacement-vector RMS/Pstar,A,Ustar <=.01 plus endpoint pressure-mode relative error<=.01. Record endpoint v/u/stress and frequency separately. Half-grid combined error must decrease16->32->64; no forced second-order claim.
actual_four_job_gate_recommendation.failure_policy: If any actual gate fails, preserve evidence and diagnose; do not tune material, weaken thresholds, extrapolate prediction into acceptance or automatically launch more refinements.

prediction_limits.finest_half: Frozen prediction supports plausibility: normalized field RMS about.001335(p),.002581(v),.000707(u),endpoint pressure -0.259888%; these are not actual solver results.
prediction_limits.dt_scaling: The prescribed coarse coupled CFL stays about.00434028, while Ddt/h² grows .00165008→.00330015→.00660031. The64 value is below the existing .01 diagnostic guard, but this does not justify extending dt proportional to dp indefinitely because diffusion scales with dp².
prediction_limits.not_simulated: Moving positions/J/C, float write-back accumulation, actual cell-list/cloning, fine GenCase seeds and complete nonlinear ComputeStep_Sym are absent from the frozen prediction. No general boundary,3D,public/GPU/formal/full-cycle acceptance or larger stable timestep follows.
